main.description: An individual podcast episode, typically imported from an RSS feed.

description.description: Episode description or show notes. May contain HTML or markdown depending on feed source.

audioUrl.description: Direct URL to the episode audio file.

showName.description: Name of the podcast show this episode belongs to.

publishedAt.description: Original publication date of the episode as declared in the feed.

episodeNumber.description: Episode number within the season or show.

guid.description: Globally unique identifier from the RSS feed, used for deduplication.

feedRef.description: AT-URI of the social.crate.rss.feed record this episode was imported from.

episodeUrl.description: Canonical web page URL for the episode, if provided by the feed.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when this record was created in the user's PDS.
